provenance: Original seeded SuperCollider synthesis using built-in UGens. No recorded audio, intelligible speech, external samples or Quarks. Wildlife/crowd are synthesized drafts for listening review, not species or human recordings.
reviewStatus: The requested core source review/refinement round is complete. Paired higher-pitched crickets and park-night are accepted alongside rain, city/car/truck, industry/clanks, park-day, birds, activity/disaster sounds, notifications and sirens. Retain the current sound identities. Optional supplemental sounds remain proposals; native/device integration and checks are pending.

samples.intent: Gentle leafy rustle and low breeze for suitable park/vegetation areas.
Light fountain water hiss and small splashes; only where water features exist.
Slow shoreline wash for appropriate lake/coastal scenery.
Low motor/mechanical bed for quieter industrial activity.
Steady motor drive with more pronounced irregular tool bursts and metal rattles.
Restrained band-limited distant city wash; wandering bass oscillator removed.
Optional stylized crowd-like murmur for active commercial areas; no words or recorded people.
Combustion pulses and tire/road whoosh with smooth approach/departure level, replacing the low rev sweep. Runtime owns position/Doppler.
Heavier pulsed engine body and tire noise with a longer passing envelope; no pure subbass rev sweep.
Short medium-register synthesized bird phrase for varied day scheduling.
Quicker higher synthesized bird phrase; no species identity claimed.
Slower lower synthesized bird phrase to vary daytime calls.
Sparse higher-pitched chirp-chirp pairs with a clear pause between the two chirps, rough wing texture and the existing overall call rate.
More overlapping voices using the same higher-pitched paired call; voice count and call-arrival rates are unchanged from the preceding dense bed.
Quiet broad wind base for light weather.
More textured gusts, to blend with actual weather intensity.
Quiet sparse pitter-patter with softer droplet attacks and less sharp high-frequency texture.
Dense surface rain and splashes with a fuller, softened wash; below the separate downpour level.
Broad wind/storm or tornado activity layer, kept separate from the accepted warning siren.
Sharper thunder onset with rolling decay; trigger only for appropriate storm events.
Rounder distant rolling thunder alternative.
Local fire body/crackle texture for an actual burning site, independent of sirens.
Short ground/structure rumble and rattling texture for an actual quake event.
Three restrained work/placement taps; no free-running building hammer actors.
Short low impact and crumble, tied to a real completed demolition.
Small soft success/confirmation cue; optional for frequent routine actions.
Gentle lower double cue for a rejected actionable command.
Warm short rising completion cue, once per newly completed objective.
Slightly fuller three-note milestone cue; notification motif, not background music.
Restrained repeated note for a newly actionable service issue.
More distinct short incident notice, subordinate to critical sirens/visible alerts.
Soft rising recovery cue for a meaningful resolved issue, without high-speed flooding.
Middle rain level: more frequent rounded drops with a restrained wash; used in the storm scene.
Torrential option with a broad but less sharp continuous wash; reserve for severe rainfall.
Distinct metal strike followed by short uneven ringing/rattle, separate from the accepted idle hum.
One isolated higher-pitched chirp-chirp call, making the two-part pattern easy to judge; also available as a future wildlife event source.

futureMixPolicy.state: Samples and offline mix illustrations only; no runtime implementation
futureMixPolicy.ambience: Area envelopes and zoom/focus drive selected local beds; broad distant mix remains quieter. Weather/day-night/season/location and actual city activity gate suitability. No ticking actor per building/citizen.
futureMixPolicy.wildlife: Schedule a small bounded pool of varied bird one-shots and suitable night-insect beds. Use natural timing variation at wall-clock speed, not simulation-speed replay.
futureMixPolicy.notifications: New actionable transitions only, deduplicated across load/resume and rate-limited/coalesced at high simulation speed. Routine confirmation cues should be optional. Audio supplements visible state.
futureMixPolicy.controls: Shared saved effects/ambience controls; later D82 music control is separate. Pause/menu/suspend/load/switch must cancel/rebuild only currently suitable layers.
futureMixPolicy.rain: Choose/crossfade light, moderate, heavy and downpour with actual rainfall intensity; do not normalize all four to the same loudness. Targets -39/-36/-33/-30 LUFS are review authoring levels, not engine mixer settings.
futureMixPolicy.review: Current requested core source refinement is complete; retain accepted sounds. Any future supplemental sources need their own listening review. No physical localization/comfort or actual voice/memory/CPU acceptance is established by these exports.

review: Focused runtime feedback: round rain droplet attacks and emphasize continuous water wash; retain four distinct loudness levels and every other accepted source.
